dct_description_sm: Historical dataset of polygon geometry features representing the transportation sectors used by the City of Baltimore's Department of Transportation. This feature class is used for general mapping/analysis purposes, as well as in the City's CitiTrak system. This file may also be used in a future web application developed for the City of Baltimore.
